001package com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.response.historyLog;
002
003import org.apache.commons.lang3.Validate;
004import com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.annotations.HistoryLogProps;
005import com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.helpers.Bytes;
006
007/**
008 * Version of the BLE SoftDevice (the Bluetooth stack on the pump's BLE processor), stored twice.
009 * Bytes 10-17 and 18-25 each hold four uint16 values in the layout of bytes 0-7 of
010 * {@link com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.response.currentStatus.BleSoftwareInfoResponse}:
011 * softDeviceId, major, minor and bugfix version. In all 77 records from seven pumps (t:slim X2 on
012 * two firmware versions and Tandem Mobi 7.6 to 7.9.0.2, 2023-2026), both blocks are either
013 * 132 / 7 / 2 / 0, the same values the pumps return in BleSoftwareInfoResponse, or all zero.
014 * What distinguishes the two blocks is not known; they have always been equal.
015 *
016 * Written right after the last 449 record in the block that follows NewDay (at midnight, and when
017 * the clock is set to a different day), and once on every restart, about 8-10 seconds after
018 * ArmInit. When a Mobi restarts on a later calendar day than it was shut down, it writes the
019 * NewDay block before the BLE processor has reported its versions: that 450 is all zero (see
020 * {@link #isKnown()}), and a filled-in 450 follows 2-3 seconds later.
021 *
022 * The class name is provisional: opcode 450 is not in Tandem's cloud event schema or the Mobi
023 * app's history log list.
024 */
025@HistoryLogProps(
026    opCode = 450,
027    displayName = "BLE SoftDevice Version"
028)
029public class BleSoftDeviceVersionHistoryLog extends HistoryLog {
030
031    private int softDeviceId;
032    private int softDeviceMajorVersion;
033    private int softDeviceMinorVersion;
034    private int softDeviceBugfixVersion;
035    private int softDeviceId2;
036    private int softDeviceMajorVersion2;
037    private int softDeviceMinorVersion2;
038    private int softDeviceBugfixVersion2;
039
040    public BleSoftDeviceVersionHistoryLog() {}
041    public BleSoftDeviceVersionHistoryLog(long pumpTimeSec, long sequenceNum, int softDeviceId, int softDeviceMajorVersion, int softDeviceMinorVersion, int softDeviceBugfixVersion, int softDeviceId2, int softDeviceMajorVersion2, int softDeviceMinorVersion2, int softDeviceBugfixVersion2) {
042        super(pumpTimeSec, sequenceNum);
043        this.cargo = buildCargo(pumpTimeSec, sequenceNum, softDeviceId, softDeviceMajorVersion, softDeviceMinorVersion, softDeviceBugfixVersion, softDeviceId2, softDeviceMajorVersion2, softDeviceMinorVersion2, softDeviceBugfixVersion2);
044        this.softDeviceId = softDeviceId;
045        this.softDeviceMajorVersion = softDeviceMajorVersion;
046        this.softDeviceMinorVersion = softDeviceMinorVersion;
047        this.softDeviceBugfixVersion = softDeviceBugfixVersion;
048        this.softDeviceId2 = softDeviceId2;
049        this.softDeviceMajorVersion2 = softDeviceMajorVersion2;
050        this.softDeviceMinorVersion2 = softDeviceMinorVersion2;
051        this.softDeviceBugfixVersion2 = softDeviceBugfixVersion2;
052    }
053
054    public int typeId() {
055        return 450;
056    }
057
058    /**
059     * <table border="1">
060     * <caption>Parsed fields for BleSoftDeviceVersionHistoryLog:</caption>
061     * <tr><td><code>softDeviceId</code></td><td><code>Bytes.readShort(raw, 10)</code></td></tr>
062     * <tr><td><code>softDeviceMajorVersion</code></td><td><code>Bytes.readShort(raw, 12)</code></td></tr>
063     * <tr><td><code>softDeviceMinorVersion</code></td><td><code>Bytes.readShort(raw, 14)</code></td></tr>
064     * <tr><td><code>softDeviceBugfixVersion</code></td><td><code>Bytes.readShort(raw, 16)</code></td></tr>
065     * <tr><td><code>softDeviceId2</code></td><td><code>Bytes.readShort(raw, 18)</code></td></tr>
066     * <tr><td><code>softDeviceMajorVersion2</code></td><td><code>Bytes.readShort(raw, 20)</code></td></tr>
067     * <tr><td><code>softDeviceMinorVersion2</code></td><td><code>Bytes.readShort(raw, 22)</code></td></tr>
068     * <tr><td><code>softDeviceBugfixVersion2</code></td><td><code>Bytes.readShort(raw, 24)</code></td></tr>
069     * </table>
070     */
071    public void parse(byte[] raw) {
072        Validate.isTrue(raw.length == 26);
073        this.cargo = raw;
074        parseBase(raw);
075        this.softDeviceId = Bytes.readShort(raw, 10);
076        this.softDeviceMajorVersion = Bytes.readShort(raw, 12);
077        this.softDeviceMinorVersion = Bytes.readShort(raw, 14);
078        this.softDeviceBugfixVersion = Bytes.readShort(raw, 16);
079        this.softDeviceId2 = Bytes.readShort(raw, 18);
080        this.softDeviceMajorVersion2 = Bytes.readShort(raw, 20);
081        this.softDeviceMinorVersion2 = Bytes.readShort(raw, 22);
082        this.softDeviceBugfixVersion2 = Bytes.readShort(raw, 24);
083    }
084
085    public static byte[] buildCargo(long pumpTimeSec, long sequenceNum, int softDeviceId, int softDeviceMajorVersion, int softDeviceMinorVersion, int softDeviceBugfixVersion, int softDeviceId2, int softDeviceMajorVersion2, int softDeviceMinorVersion2, int softDeviceBugfixVersion2) {
086        return HistoryLog.fillCargo(Bytes.combine(
087            HistoryLog.typeIdBytes(450, 0),
088            Bytes.toUint32(pumpTimeSec),
089            Bytes.toUint32(sequenceNum),
090            Bytes.firstTwoBytesLittleEndian(softDeviceId),
091            Bytes.firstTwoBytesLittleEndian(softDeviceMajorVersion),
092            Bytes.firstTwoBytesLittleEndian(softDeviceMinorVersion),
093            Bytes.firstTwoBytesLittleEndian(softDeviceBugfixVersion),
094            Bytes.firstTwoBytesLittleEndian(softDeviceId2),
095            Bytes.firstTwoBytesLittleEndian(softDeviceMajorVersion2),
096            Bytes.firstTwoBytesLittleEndian(softDeviceMinorVersion2),
097            Bytes.firstTwoBytesLittleEndian(softDeviceBugfixVersion2)));
098    }
099
100    /**
101     * 132 in every non-zero record; equals BleSoftwareInfoResponse.softDeviceId.
102     *
103     * @return the SoftDevice identifier from the first block (uint16 at offset 10)
104     */
105    public int getSoftDeviceId() {
106        return softDeviceId;
107    }
108
109    /**
110     * @return the SoftDevice major version from the first block (uint16 at offset 12)
111     */
112    public int getSoftDeviceMajorVersion() {
113        return softDeviceMajorVersion;
114    }
115
116    /**
117     * @return the SoftDevice minor version from the first block (uint16 at offset 14)
118     */
119    public int getSoftDeviceMinorVersion() {
120        return softDeviceMinorVersion;
121    }
122
123    /**
124     * @return the SoftDevice bugfix version from the first block (uint16 at offset 16)
125     */
126    public int getSoftDeviceBugfixVersion() {
127        return softDeviceBugfixVersion;
128    }
129
130    /**
131     * Second block, same layout as the first; equal to it in every observed record. Its meaning
132     * is unknown.
133     *
134     * @return the SoftDevice identifier from the second block (uint16 at offset 18)
135     */
136    public int getSoftDeviceId2() {
137        return softDeviceId2;
138    }
139
140    /**
141     * @return the SoftDevice major version from the second block (uint16 at offset 20)
142     */
143    public int getSoftDeviceMajorVersion2() {
144        return softDeviceMajorVersion2;
145    }
146
147    /**
148     * @return the SoftDevice minor version from the second block (uint16 at offset 22)
149     */
150    public int getSoftDeviceMinorVersion2() {
151        return softDeviceMinorVersion2;
152    }
153
154    /**
155     * @return the SoftDevice bugfix version from the second block (uint16 at offset 24)
156     */
157    public int getSoftDeviceBugfixVersion2() {
158        return softDeviceBugfixVersion2;
159    }
160
161    /**
162     * False for an all-zero record: a Mobi writes one when it records the NewDay block during a
163     * restart, before the BLE processor has reported its versions. The filled-in record follows a
164     * few seconds later. Treat an all-zero record as "not yet known", not as version 0.0.0.
165     *
166     * @return true if either block holds a non-zero value
167     */
168    public boolean isKnown() {
169        return softDeviceId != 0 || softDeviceMajorVersion != 0 || softDeviceMinorVersion != 0 || softDeviceBugfixVersion != 0
170            || softDeviceId2 != 0 || softDeviceMajorVersion2 != 0 || softDeviceMinorVersion2 != 0 || softDeviceBugfixVersion2 != 0;
171    }
172
173    /**
174     * @return the first block's version as "major.minor.bugfix" (e.g. "7.2.0"), or null if the
175     *         first block is all zero
176     */
177    public String getVersionString() {
178        return versionString(softDeviceId, softDeviceMajorVersion, softDeviceMinorVersion, softDeviceBugfixVersion);
179    }
180
181    /**
182     * @return the second block's version as "major.minor.bugfix" (e.g. "7.2.0"), or null if the
183     *         second block is all zero
184     */
185    public String getVersionString2() {
186        return versionString(softDeviceId2, softDeviceMajorVersion2, softDeviceMinorVersion2, softDeviceBugfixVersion2);
187    }
188
189    private static String versionString(int id, int major, int minor, int bugfix) {
190        if (id == 0 && major == 0 && minor == 0 && bugfix == 0) {
191            return null;
192        }
193        return major + "." + minor + "." + bugfix;
194    }
195}
